item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.31)] Pass the Passkey: A Novel Attack Surface in Passwordless Authentication
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.31)
This article analyzes new attack classes, dubbed "Pass-ta-key," "Silver Pass-ta-key," and "Golden Pass-ta-key," against passwordless authentication, specifically targeting Google's synced passkey ecosystem. These attacks demonstrate how malware on a compromised endpoint can exploit onboarding, recovery, and device trust workflows to take over passkey-protected accounts, enabling authentication without user interaction, bypassing user verification, and even extracting private keys. The research emphasizes that while passkeys enhance security, their implementation can still create novel attack surfaces, necessitating strict validation and hardened recovery flows to maintain their intended security benefits.
